payload.description:
About the Position

As part of the CoNetrix Security team, an IT Audit Tech is expected to analyze complex IT environments from a security and compliance perspective. This includes reviewing policy and procedural controls, assessing the effectiveness of technical controls, writing audit reports, and communicating with lead auditors about the analysis, prepared documents and recommended findings.

You must be authorized for permanent work in the USA.

About CoNetrix Security

CoNetrix Security specializes in providing assurance testing and security consulting services to help financial institutions address cybersecurity concerns, stay safe from evolving threats, and compliant with complex information security regulations. Dating back to 2001, CoNetrix Security has provided IT audits, vulnerability assessments, penetration tests and consulting services to community banks, credit unions, and other security conscious companies.

payload.title: Available Now - IT Network Engineer
payload.description:
About the Position

A Network Engineer at CoNetrix should be an excellent problem solver, have good customer service skills, be willing to work as part of a team, maintain attention to detail, and have a passion for technology. As part of the CoNetrix Technology team, you will work with our customers to provide quality and timely installation and support of their IT environments.

You must be authorized for permanent work in the USA and live in the Lubbock, Texas area. This job is in our main office in Lubbock.

Tasks & Responsibilities

Here are some examples of what you could expect to do as part of this position:

  • Handle day-to-day IT issues for our customers
  • Contribute to various network implementation and upgrade projects
  • Perform routine maintenance for customer IT networks
  • Work 8-9 hours per day with paid overtime
  • Occasional after-hours work and regional day-travel is typical

Physical Requirements

To effectively perform this job, you should be able to:

  • Walk frequently.
  • Talk and listen on phone calls with customers and team members.
  • Position yourself as needed to work around and beneath desks and equipment.
